csv_project_name: Engineering for PHA Houston Ship Channel Maritime Strategic
csv_scope_of_work: MARITIME STRATEGIC PROJECT PLANNING, ENGINEERING, AND CONSTRUCTION COORDINATION AND OTHER GENERAL ASSISTANCE FOR THE HOUSTON SHIP CHANNEL AND PORT OWNED TERMINALS The Port of Houston Authority (PHA) is the local sponsor of the Houston Ship Channel (HSC) and tributary channels at Bayport, Barbours Cut, Greens Bayou, and Jacintoport. The HSC is approximately 52 miles in length and has several hundreds of acres of both submerged and upland confined dredge material placement areas (DMPA). The tributary channels range from approximately 0.5- miles to 4 miles in length and use the same DMPAs as the HSC. PHA is seeking to engage the services of up to two registered professional engineering firms with technical expertise specific to the Texas Gulf Coast maritime environment in navigation, dredging, dredge material management, and ports further described in Section II (Scope of Services) to support PHA while working with the USACE to maintain the HSC, PHA berths, and DMPA sites, which may include but not limited to project coordination, strategic planning and advocacy, engineering, design, construction management, and other general assistance. PHA expects the selected consultant(s) to have extensive knowledge across various disciplines to support the Port Authority s partnership with USACE, including, but not limited to strategic planning and execution expertise in: federal funding and authorization processes, federal regulatory permitting, state and federal agency resource coordination, port planning and infrastructure, 843.225 Revision: 0 2026-02-12 large-scale ship simulation studies, navigation shoaling mitigation, hydrodynamic modeling, Geographic Information Systems (GIS) development and maintenance, dredged material management planning, DMPA development, sediment testing, Lands, Easements, Right of Ways, Relocations, and Disposals (LERRD) support, geotechnical engineering, hydrographic surveying, community engagement, and other general administrative services.
csv_disciplines_requested: Geotechnical Engineering, Soil Testing, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Mechanical Engineering, Hydrology/Hydraulics
